jobs.title: Senior Account Executive I (General Manager/Influencer, DI, North America)
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Senior Account Executive I to own go to market for our General Manager and Influencer products across Division I athletic departments, from first conversation to signed agreement. I'm Joe Miller https://www.linkedin.com/in/joe-miller-76605853/, Director, Sales at Teamworks. Our General Manager product is quickly becoming a product that touches nearly every DI athletic department, and this role sits right at the center of that growth.

You'll be joining a sales team that's expanding its footprint across college athletics, working alongside Territory Leads to drive Elite sales and partnering closely with our Wallet team to grow adoption of Wallet alongside GM and Influencer. This is a high-volume, relationship-driven role where you'll build your own pipeline, run your own demos, and work the full deal cycle from sourcing to close.


THE ROLE

 - Own the full sales cycle for General Manager and Influencer, from sourcing leads to executing agreements

 - Run product demos independently and tell a compelling story tailored to different stakeholders, from athletic directors to CFOs

 - Partner closely with Territory Leads in working with customers on packaging, including GM and Influencer

 - Build and leverage high-level relationships within athletic departments to open new opportunities

 - Work closely with our product team to translate customer feedback into product improvements

 - Collaborate with our Wallet team to drive adoption of Wallet alongside GM and Influencer


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - Background in budgeting or revenue share, ideally within a college athletics business office, so you can speak credibly to the financial tradeoffs our customers are weighing

 - Direct experience working within a Division I athletic department, so you understand firsthand the operational and budget realities our customers face

 - Proven ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced processes

 - Strong track record of collaborating within a team-based sales motion, this is not a role for someone used to working independently outside of a broader team

 - Based in the US, with willingness to travel as needed


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You've held a CFO or business office title within a college athletic department

 - You have experience navigating conversations with both athletic directors and finance leaders on the same deal

 - You’ve had experience working directly with agents, athletes, etc. on revenue share agreements and/or you’ve worked directly with teams on campus with budgeting for NIL, negotiating contracts, etc.


WHY THIS ROLE

You'll be selling a product that's actively reshaping how every Division I athletic department manages its business operations, while joining a fast-growing team with real momentum in sports tech. You'll work at the intersection of sales and product, with a direct line to influence what we build next.



This role is not eligible for sponsorship at this time.



Please submit your application through this posting only. We're unable to review applications or resumes sent via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels.



To all recruitment agencies: Teamworks does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Teamworks employees or any other organization location. Teamworks is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.



ABOUT TEAMWORKS

We're the Operating System for Sports™, powering 7,000+ organizations worldwide, from collegiate programs to every major pro league. Founded in 2006, we've evolved from a messaging tool for college football into the leading sports tech platform, with 600+ global teammates building the future of sports tech. Our solutions span Personnel, Coaching, Performance, Operations, and Intelligence - helping teams recruit smarter, train better, stay compliant, and win.

Teamworks is an equal opportunity employer - if you live our core values every day and are honest, hardworking, humble, committed, innovative, and an all-around exceptional person, you'll thrive at Teamworks. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and take affirmative action to not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics.  This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, compensation, benefits, and training. Teamworks is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to build the attribution and tracking foundation that gives us a trusted picture of marketing's influence across the customer journey, and to lead the shift from manual campaign and event work into automation. I'm Karla Anderson https://www.linkedin.com/in/karla-anderson/, EVP, Marketing at Teamworks, and this role reports directly to me. Marketing operations has lived in different places across the company over the past few years, and I'm bringing it back under one clear owner inside marketing. With 25 products across multiple markets, connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue is complex. Getting it right takes someone who understands both the mechanics of marketing operations and the nuance of enterprise B2B attribution. You'll map our journey end to end, from campaigns and events to website engagement and in-app messaging, and build the tracking infrastructure that lets us trust the numbers behind the funnel.

This is also a chance to shape what an AI-native marketing function looks like at Teamworks. We want a team that builds automation and agents into how we work, not as a side experiment, but as core infrastructure that scales campaign execution, list building, and reporting across demand gen and product marketing. You'll have real ownership here and the freedom to build this function largely from scratch.


THE ROLE

 - Map end-to-end marketing attribution and build the tracking that shows how demand gen and product marketing campaigns influence pipeline and revenue

 - Own the systems and setup behind every campaign, event, and in-app message, including list building and lifecycle triggers, so tracking works correctly from day one

 - Lead the shift from manual campaign and project work into automated workflows, freeing our team to focus on strategy instead of setup

 - Partner with Tech Ops and RevOps to keep marketing data clean and aligned across the stack, without duplicating work already happening elsewhere

 - Build our AI native marketing function, designing and shipping the automations and agents that scale work across demand gen and product marketing


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - 4-5 years running marketing operations in a complex, enterprise B2B environment, not a startup or single-product business, because Teamworks' multi-product, multi-market structure makes attribution genuinely harder to map

 - A track record of building marketing attribution and campaign tracking from scratch, not just maintaining systems someone else designed

 - Direct experience shifting marketing work from manual to automated, including AI-built automations or agents, not just using AI tools day to day

 - Working knowledge of the marketing tech stack, including how campaign, CRM, and in-app messaging systems connect and where data breaks down

 - Comfort operating as a team of one, owning strategy and execution without a team to delegate to, at least initially


EVEN BETTER IF

 - Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or customer.io or an equivalent in-app messaging platform

 - Familiarity with website analytics tools like Google Analytics and how to tie web behavior into the broader attribution picture

 - Background in sports, media, or another complex vertical


WHY THIS ROLE

This function doesn't exist yet in its current form, which means you get to define it. You'll set the standard for how marketing operations runs at Teamworks, build the attribution model the business will use to judge marketing's contribution to revenue, and help lead the shift into an AI native way of working, all while operating across a genuinely complex, global, multi-product business.
